raw_response: {"findings":[{"path":"tornado/ioloop.py","line":251,"end_line":254,"severity":"high","category":"bug","title":"initialize(make_current=True) 的条件判断反了，导致无法显式设为当前 IOLoop","explanation":"当 make_current 为真时，代码在 `IOLoop.current(instance=False) is None`（即当前线程还没有 IOLoop）时抛出 RuntimeError(\"current IOLoop already exists\")，而在已经存在当前 IOLoop 时反而调用 make_current() 覆盖它。这与文档语义（显式要求把本实例设为当前，若已有当前实例才应报错）完全相反：没有当前实例时本应成功设为当前，却抛异常；已有当前实例时本应报错，却静默覆盖。","trigger":"在无当前 IOLoop 的线程中执行 `IOLoop().initialize(make_current=True)`。","evidence":"第 251-254 行：`elif make_current:` 分支内 `if IOLoop.current(instance=False) is None: raise RuntimeError(\"current IOLoop already exists\")`，随后 `self.make_current()`。条件与错误信息矛盾：None 表示不存在当前实例，不应报“已存在”。","suggestion":"将条件改为 `if IOLoop.current(instance=False) is not None: raise RuntimeError(...)`，再调用 `self.make_current()`。"}]}
